CVE-2026-3505.de6dd1e538465235db3036a8d3d889eaa9698919:
Revert "OpenPGP v6 SEIPDv2 AEAD chunkSize is unbounded on decrypt → 1L<<(chunkSize+6) buffer: chunkSize 24 → 1 GiB alloc (memory-DoS), 25 → NegativeArraySizeException. Concrete sibling asymmetry: v5 AEADEncDataPacket:51 has if (chunkSize > 16) throw (CVE-2026-3505) but v6 SymmetricEncIntegrityPacket:54 reads chunkSize=in.read() with no bound — the missed sibling. Attacker needs only the recipient's public key."

This reverts commit 12f6884e4f647e13cca0c725a3233b216a3b485a.
